items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Ah, there's one New Orleans musician I've never heard of.

ctx.x: too. I don't know if he had anybody in that band from New Orleans. But I couldn't remember... They had a guy named Fess Duncan; Duncan Fess, they called him -- he was from New Orleans. Pretty good piano player.
Ah, there's one New Orleans musician I've never heard of.

But what got us, instead of Bespawn(?) and Hill putting in a transfer, like they're supposed to... In San Francisco, when you got there, before you hit one note, you put in your transfer. But we didn't do it. And we had a radio show to play. I'll never forget it. And Phil Harris was the emcee at the time on this radio station in San Francisco.
